description: Only the urgency of school repairs changes. Housing needs, authority, finances, and the available packages remain the same.
invariants: World, role, powers, housing need, ownership, financing, option wording, scores, reasons and institutional notes remain fixed.
interpretation_limit: Fixed order and recognition prevent a causal urgency estimate; the repeated scenario is excluded from aggregates.

description: replace “In the past year the manager has used that power twice” with “In the past year the manager has not used that power.”
invariants: Retain the manager's legal capacity, notice period, housing supply, all option text, costs, and safeguards.
interpretation_limit: This tests sensitivity to exercised interference while the capacity to interfere is constant. Changed answers could also reflect inferred trustworthiness or urgency; they do not establish an individual causal estimate or a definitive non-domination belief. Ask whether the participant imagined unstated misconduct.

description: replace the sentence about how care began with “When the caring arrangements began, the carers were assigned the role without being asked.”
invariants: Current willingness to continue under every package, freedom to stop without penalty, recipient needs, exhaustion, capacity, consent to visits, available actions, and the officer's powers remain fixed.
interpretation_limit: The assignment describes the past; it does not create a present legal or family power to compel care. This is a proposed contrast about the history of consent, not a claim that consent history is independent of all real-world consequences. Probe whether the respondent changed the stipulated current willingness or imagined coercion continuing now. If the variant is understood as changing present coercion or family safety, revise it or drop the contrast.

description: change only the member resolution to “detecting short, localized peaks is the primary task; estimating average exposure across the neighborhood is a secondary task.”
invariants: Equipment, sample budget, participation costs, personnel, prior survey, and choices remain identical.
interpretation_limit: A change can reflect attention to the evidential task rather than a political worldview. This is a useful check against attributing every methodological preference to ideology. If an option becomes obviously required by the wording, retain the variant as a comprehension probe rather than a discriminating assessment item.

description: replace only the fund-origin sentence with “The fund's money came from national transfers received over the past decade and now legally belongs to the public fund, not to individual contributors.”
invariants: Preserve the ten-year accumulation period, amount, household counts, public legal status, lack of prior promises, contribution records, eligibility, and lottery design.
interpretation_limit: The contrast explores whether the perceived source of a common resource changes the weight of residence or contribution. It does not isolate attitudes to immigration, nationality, ancestry, or cultural difference. The term “newer household” must not quietly become “foreign household.”

description: replace only the species-range sentences with “This is the species' only remaining breeding colony. Its loss would mean the species becomes extinct.”
invariants: Preserve the local ecological functions, numbers of jobs, public cost, risk ranges, authority, income bridge, and every option.
interpretation_limit: The changed fact alters the scope and irreversibility of loss. It cannot by itself distinguish intrinsic ecological value from human concern about rarity or future option value.

description: replace only “It has not provided a remedy for that policy” with “Five years ago it completed a compensation agreement for the policy, negotiated with elected representatives of affected former applicants; the agreement did not decide future course admissions.”
invariants: Keep the historical exclusion, current applicants, group counts, low-income distribution, course budget, authority, and allocation options fixed.
interpretation_limit: This tests sensitivity to a prior institutional remedy. Agreement that the remedy actually settles an obligation is an interpretation to elicit, not a factual answer to impose. If “completed compensation” is heard as proof that all social disadvantage vanished, revise the wording.
